sources.supports: Device Hub manages simulated and physical run destinations, with live device windows and sidebar selection.
Use selected device and View Screen in Device Hub; root retained official markdown scratch only.
Device Hub ships with Xcode27 and can be used without launching Xcode.

supportedRoute: Launch Device Hub app, choose owned simulator in sidebar, verify Info device ID and live View Screen via computer-use before measurement.
cliSelection: No documented exact-device CLI argument found in inspected primary docs; no CurrentDeviceUDID strings in either local executable. Absence of strings is not a proof no internal support exists. Do not guess URL syntax or transfer old Simulator flags.
lifecycleFindings: Outer bundle entry is DevicesTrampoline, whose imports include first-launch package installer and posix_spawnp. Its postlaunch PID relationship is not established by static inspection.

Actual DeviceHub executable imports NSApplication. Directly spawning it provides an exact child process for ownership, but this is a local entry-point inference, not a documented DeviceHub command-line interface.
Any next controller needs guards covering Simulator, DeviceHub, Devices, DevicesTrampoline and actual app paths; current absence is only a point-in-time observation.
recommendation: Prepare revised actual-DeviceHub direct-child lifecycle for root review, with no old CurrentDeviceUDID argument; exact owned device selected and verified through sky after registered launch. Do not proceed from static evidence alone to claim visible window or successful launch.
